verdict.rationale: The docs describe a dedicated plugin browser (`/plugins` in Codex CLI, a Plugins tab in ChatGPT) for browsing and installing from configured marketplaces. A marketplace.json catalog with categories and a public openai/plugins GitHub listing let developers look over plugins and their bundled skills before installing. Curated skills in openai/skills can also be reviewed and then installed by name via `$skill-installer`. Missing for 10: explicit search/filter within the catalog is not documented, there is no hands-on or independent corroboration of the browse experience, and standalone curated skills lack a documented in-product browsing UI separate from plugins.
